name: single-cell-in-a-field-mm
description: Interface-substitutability twin of the flagship: BYTE-IDENTICAL cell<->field ports, but the internal metabolism behind CpmCellField is swapped from constraint-based dynamic-FBA (e_coli_core, O2-capped) to a lumped Michaelis-Menten / Monod metabolism (mechanism='mm', no cobra): uptake v = mm_vmax*glc/(mm_km+glc), biomass gain mm_yield*v, acetate overflow mm_overflow*v. The MM params are TUNED so the interface-level observables (biomass trajectory, acetate secretion, CPM growth, net glucose depletion) track the dFBA flagship -- demonstrating the paper's central claim (section 2 / Cellular interface) that different internal organizations can realize the SAME coarse-grained interface when they preserve the interaction variables relevant to that description. Same field, same DiffusionAdvection, same gradient as the flagship; only the box behind the ports differs.
